```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP) Test Suite for U04_2

**Test Case ID** | **Title** | **Requirement ID(s)** | **Kind** | **Preconditions** | **Input(s)** | **Steps** | **Expected**
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
TC-001 | Patient generates consultation request | VIRTUA-2.2-5 | Positive | Patient is logged in | Consultation request details | Patient submits request | Doctor receives request and sees it in their dashboard
TC-002 | Doctor diagnoses patient | VIRTUA-2.2-5 | Positive | Doctor is logged in and has received request | Diagnosis details | Doctor enters diagnosis and submits it | Patient receives notification of diagnosis
TC-003 | Doctor generates prescription | VIRTUA-2.2-6 | Positive | Doctor has diagnosis | Prescription details | Doctor enters prescription details and submits it | Patient receives prescription, chemist receives notification, and labs receive notification
TC-004 | Chemist delivers medicines | VIRTUA-2.2-7 | Positive | Chemist is logged in and receives prescription | Medicine details | Chemist verifies prescription and delivers medicines to patient
TC-005 | Labs collect specimen | VIRTUA-2.2-8 | Positive | Lab is logged in and receives prescription | Specimen details | Lab collects specimen from patient and submits it | Patient receives notification of lab report and it is updated in the system
TC-006 | Admin sets up specialties | VIRTUA-2.3-1 | Positive | Admin is logged in | Specialty details | Admin enters specialty details and submits it | Specialty is added to the system
TC-007 | Admin adds doctor | VIRTUA-2.3-2 | Positive | Admin is logged in | Doctor details | Admin enters doctor details and submits it | Doctor is added to the system
TC-008 | Admin adds lab | VIRTUA-2.3-3 | Positive | Admin is logged in | Lab details | Admin enters lab details and submits it | Lab is added to the system
TC-009 | Admin edits doctor information | VIRTUA-2.3-4 | Positive | Admin is logged in and selects doctor | Updated doctor details | Admin edits doctor details and submits it | Doctor information is updated in the system
```
